privateDeals.what: SpaceX completed acquisition of Anysphere Inc. (Cursor) for 389,289,254 SpaceX Class A shares at an implied Cursor equity value of $60.0B (agreement June 16, 2026)
SpaceX IPO on Nasdaq at $135/share; raised about $75B base (about $86B with overallotment) at ~$1.77T valuation - largest IPO ever
SpaceX acquired xAI in all-stock merger valuing combined company at $1.25T (SpaceX $1T, xAI $250B)
Tesla invested $2.0B in xAI preferred stock, converted into SpaceX common (<1% stake), accounted for under equity method
SpaceX agreed to buy EchoStar AWS-4, H-Block and AWS-3 spectrum licenses; FCC approved May 12, 2026, first-step transfer closed May 22, 2026
xAI signed compute deals: Anthropic to pay $1.25B/month for Colossus 1 capacity (May 2026); Google $920M/month (June 2026)
Neuralink raised ~$600-650M Series E at ~$9B valuation (led by ARK, Sequoia, Founders Fund)

realEstate.type: Condominiums and land (1,000+ acres) held via ~37 companies appearing to be for Musk's personal use (NYT Feb 2026 report, as summarized)

trophies.what: X (formerly Twitter), bought for $44B in 2022; now part of xAI/SpaceX
Private jets used by Musk owned by Falcon Landing LLC, a SpaceX-linked company

policy.what: Delaware Supreme Court (Dec 19, 2025) reinstated Musk's 2018 Tesla pay package in Tornetta case, awarding $1 nominal damages; Tesla board then forfeited 96M-share 2025 interim award (Apr 21, 2026)
Tesla shareholders approved ~$1T 2025 CEO performance award (up to ~12% of Tesla stock over 10 yrs) with >75% support, Nov 6, 2025
San Francisco federal jury found Musk liable for misleading Twitter investors via two 2022 tweets (Mar 20, 2026); plaintiffs estimate damages up to ~$2.6B
SEC suit (filed Jan 14, 2025) over late disclosure of Twitter stake; $1.5M settlement announced May 2026, pending court approval
Musk v. Altman/OpenAI: Oakland jury found claims time-barred (May 18, 2026); Musk said he will appeal to 9th Circuit
European Commission fined X/xAI/Musk EUR 120M under Digital Services Act (Dec 5, 2025); challenged at EU General Court Feb 16, 2026
Twitter (X) patent case: jury awarded Vidstream $105M (Apr 2025) plus $67M prejudgment interest; on appeal at Federal Circuit
Tesla discloses ongoing information requests/subpoenas from NHTSA, NTSB, SEC, DOJ on Autopilot/FSD, Robotaxi and other topics; derivative suits over Musk, X and xAI pending in Delaware

Court approval of $1.5M SEC settlement over Twitter stake disclosure
Musk appeal of OpenAI verdict at 9th Circuit
